falseSynonyms.zh: 避開不等於 overcome avoid 是繞開問題；overcome 是面對並成功克服。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Avoiding and overcoming are opposite strategies.

falseSynonyms.zh: 忽略不等於 overcome ignore 只是沒有理會，問題可能仍然存在。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Ignoring does not solve a difficulty.

falseSynonyms.zh: 忍受不等於 overcome endure 表示承受困難，不一定成功克服。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Endurance is not necessarily victory.

falseSynonyms.zh: 接受不等於 overcome accept 可以和問題共存，而不是消除或跨越它。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Acceptance is different from overcoming.

falseSynonyms.zh: 逃離不等於 overcome escape 表示離開危險／困境，不一定真正處理問題。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Escape avoids or leaves the difficulty.

falseSynonyms.zh: 只在問題被真正解決 sense 接近 overcome 可以成功應對一個仍然存在的困難。
較強的近義詞 conquer 帶戰勝／征服感，強度通常高於 overcome。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Conquer is stronger and more combative.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞形陷阱 現在式 overcome；過去式 overcame；過去分詞 overcome。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The past tense is overcame; the past participle is overcome.
